sources.title: codegeex4-all-9b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Q: How does CodeGeeX4-ALL-9B compare to Codestral-22B for code generation? A: CodeGeeX4 achieves 82.3% on HumanEval versus Codestral's 81.1%, and 40.4% on NaturalCodeBench versus Codestral's 46.0%. CodeGeeX4 is faster due to smaller size (9B vs 22B parameters) and uses less VRAM, making it better for resource-constrained deployments.
